question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, “Seema Darshan Project adds a new dimension to the tourism sector”. This project will boost tourism in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Former Gujarat CM Vijay Rupani has approved the Rs.39 Cr Seema Darshan**.
 
• **This** project is for developing more infrastructure facilities at **Nadabet near Suigam in the Banaskantha district.**
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi said,** “Seema Darshan Project adds a new dimension to the tourism sector”.**
 
• The project is being developed on the** Wagah Border pattern & entails a parade ground with an amphitheatre.**
 
• The project will encourage local **economic activity in the Rann region & tourists can have a good view of the coastline.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gujarat:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Bhupendra Patel.
 
• Governor - Acharya Devvrat.
 
• State Animal - Asiatic lion.
 
• State Bird - Greater flamingo.
 
• National Parks - Vansda National Park, Blackbuck National Park, Gir Forest National Park, Marine National Park.
 
• Dams - Sardar Sarovar Dam(Narmada River), Ukai Dam (Tapti River), Dantiwada Dam (Banas River), Kadana Dam (Mahi River), Kamleshwar Dam (Hiran River).
 
• Registered GI: Agates of Cambay, Kutch Embroidery, Patan Patola, Tangaliya Shawl.
